sloka: क्रूरैः अनार्यैः सौमित्रे परिहासः कथंचन ।न कार्यः पश्य वैदेहीम् कथंचित् सौम्य जीवतीम् ॥३-१८-१९॥
transliteration: krūraiḥ anāryaiḥ saumitre parihāsaḥ kathaṁcana ।na kāryaḥ paśya vaidehīm kathaṁcit saumya jīvatīm ॥3-18-19॥

translations.english: O handsome Lakshmana it is not proper to cut jokes with wicked, uncivilized persons. Now see Sita who has somehow survived.
